title: Next Step Action Plan
description: NEW at Next Step v1.0 — the broad, reusable roadmap document that a receipt (receipt.schema.json) links a single task to. Contains one or more tasks. Not scoped to a single agent or session. The AI agent building a task never sees this document directly — only the narrower receipt derived from it. Design formalization, not yet exercised against a real implementation.

title.description: Short human-readable name for the plan.

description.description: Full description of the plan's overall goal and boundaries — the scope that individual tasks' receipts are validated against.

created_by.description: Identity of the human or process that authored this plan. An action plan is a human-authorized artifact, consistent with the protocol's human-only authorization model.

workspace_id.description: Optional. If the plan is scoped to a single workspace; omit if it spans multiple.

tasks.description: One or more planned task entries. Each entry describes a task's intended scope before it is built — not the built task.manifest itself.

plan_task_id.description: Identity of this task-slot within the plan. Distinct from any built TASK_ID — a plan task may be rebuilt multiple times before a receipt is finalized.

intent.description: What this task within the plan is meant to accomplish.

scope_boundary.description: The explicit scope boundary the staging pipeline will validate a submitted receipt against for this task-slot.

status.description: Tracked at the plan level, independent of the individual receipt's own status field.

receipt_id.description: Set once a task has been built and a receipt generated for this slot. Optional/absent until then.

status.description: Overall plan status. A plan can remain ACTIVE with some tasks COMPLETE and others NOT_STARTED — it is a reusable roadmap, not a single-shot document.
